title: Successful Google OAuth sign-in
expected_result: Authenticated session is created only after successful callback; user lands on Product Catalog.

title: Add Classic Tee to cart
expected_result: Cart count increments; Classic Tee appears as a line item with unit price INR 799.

title: Remove item from cart
steps: Ensure cart has at least one line item
expected_result: Line item is removed and bill preview recalculates immediately.

title: Apply SAVE10 discount on single GST item
expected_result: Discount INR 249.90 applied; GST and payable total match billing rules (payable 2653.94).

title: Happy path card checkout with free shipping
steps: Pay with Credit Debit Card successfully
expected_result: Order Confirmation shows order ID and payable total matching Review Cart; delivery charges are 0.
